preview: A thing left out in a shared home can mean different things to different people. In this episode, we look at a study of homes in New Zealand and ask what we should understand before deciding whether something is clutter.
comment_1: Listen for why one person kept the supplements where they could be seen.
comment_2: So far, we’ve heard that keeping the supplement in sight can help someone remember to take it. But what might change if it is put away?
comment_3: The same item can look like clutter to one person and a helpful reminder to another. As you listen next, notice what these visible things mean to the people who live in the home.
comment_4: The story asks us to look at things left out with care, because they may have a purpose. At the same time, the study did not test whether the supplement worked as a reminder. Let’s hear the closing summary.
